generic.Defined scope/population: All field investigation activities required by the investigation plan on this claim.
generic.In-scope period: From claim assignment through the report-back date set on each field activity.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each field activity carries assignee name, inspection scope, photo requirement and due date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of plan field tasks equals count of field activities created in ClaimCenter.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Assignment letters and acknowledgements stored in the claim repository with send timestamps.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Declined or unacknowledged assignments logged with the reassignment decision.
generic.Test population: Every open field investigation activity on the claim.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: 100% of field activities show a named assignee and a due date.
generic.Exception handling path: Unacknowledged assignment escalated to the Claims Coordinator for panel reassignment.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Activity accepted when assignee, scope, photo requirements and report-back date are all recorded.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter activity log and the claim file assignment correspondence folder.

steps.title: List unassigned field investigation items in ClaimCenter
sop: Open the claim in Guidewire ClaimCenter and go to the investigation plan section.
List every field task that has no named field resource against it.
Done when all unallocated field tasks are listed for assignment.
verify: Compare the list against the field workstream in the investigation plan.
Pass when no plan field task is missing from the list.

steps.title: Select the field adjuster or approved panel firm in ClaimCenter
sop: Filter the ClaimCenter vendor list to approved independent adjusting firms for the loss state.
Pick a staff field adjuster first and a panel firm only where no staff capacity exists.
Done when a named resource is selected for each field task.
verify: Check the selected firm appears on the approved vendor panel.
Pass when every selection is a staff adjuster or a panel-approved firm.

steps.title: Verify adjuster licence is active in the loss state
sop: Check the adjuster licence record held against the vendor in ClaimCenter.
Confirm the licence covers the loss state and has not expired.
Done when licence status is confirmed active before dispatch.
verify: Re-read the licence expiry date against the planned inspection date.
Pass when the licence is active for the loss state on the inspection date.

steps.title: Create the field activity with scope and due date in ClaimCenter
sop: Create one ClaimCenter activity per field task with the assignee set.
State inspection scope, photo requirements and the report-back date in the activity.
Done when every field task exists as a dated ClaimCenter activity.
verify: Open each new activity and check assignee, scope and due date are populated.
Pass when no field activity is missing an assignee or a due date.

steps.title: Issue the assignment instruction from the claim file repository
sop: Generate the assignment instruction letter and attach the FNOL and loss photographs.
Send it to the field resource and file the sent copy in the claim repository.
Done when the instruction is sent and filed on the claim.
verify: Check the filed instruction states scope, photo requirements and report-back date.
Pass when the filed copy carries a send timestamp.

steps.title: Log the field resource acknowledgement on the claim
sop: Chase any field resource that has not acknowledged within one business day.
Record the acknowledgement date and time as a claim note in ClaimCenter.
Done when every dispatched assignment shows a logged acknowledgement or a reassignment.
verify: Review the activity list for assignments with no acknowledgement note.
Pass when every open field activity is acknowledged or reassigned.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every milestone in the investigation plan covering coverage, liability and damages workstreams.
generic.In-scope period: From plan drafting to plan approval and through any later plan revision.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each milestone carries one named owner, a backup owner where needed and a due date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Milestone count in the plan equals the count of owner-assigned ClaimCenter activities.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Each plan version retained in the claim repository with its assignment date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unassigned milestones flagged and cleared with the owner named before approval.
generic.Test population: All milestones listed in the current investigation plan version.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero milestones without exactly one named owner.
generic.Exception handling path: Milestones with no available owner escalated to the Claims Examiner for reallocation.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Assignment accepted when owner, backup and mirrored claim activity all exist for the milestone.
generic.Evidence location: Investigation plan workbook in the claim repository and ClaimCenter activity list.

steps.title: Extract the milestone list from the plan workbook in Excel
sop: Open the investigation plan workbook in Microsoft Excel from the claim repository.
List every milestone across the coverage, liability and damages workstreams.
Done when a single milestone list is produced for owner allocation.
verify: Compare the extracted list against the plan narrative sections.
Pass when no plan milestone is absent from the list.

steps.title: Name one owner per milestone in the Excel plan workbook
sop: Enter a single named owner in the owner column against each milestone.
Assign coverage, liability and damages workstreams to separately named owners.
Done when every milestone row shows exactly one owner name.
verify: Filter the owner column for blanks and for multiple names in one cell.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Assign complex-loss milestones to the specialist in ClaimCenter
sop: Review milestones tied to large-loss or disputed-causation issues.
Take ownership of those milestones and record acceptance in ClaimCenter.
Done when specialist-owned milestones show the specialist as owner.
verify: Check each complex milestone against the specialist referral criteria.
Pass when every complex milestone is owned by the specialist.

steps.title: Record backup owners for planned absence in the workbook
sop: Check the milestone dates against known leave and absence for each owner.
Enter a backup owner name for any milestone falling in an absence window.
Done when every affected milestone carries a backup owner.
verify: Cross-check milestone dates against the team absence calendar.
Pass when no milestone in an absence window lacks a backup owner.

steps.title: Mirror owner assignments as ClaimCenter activities
sop: Create a ClaimCenter activity for each milestone assigned to its named owner.
Set the activity due date to the milestone date from the workbook.
Done when each milestone exists as an owned claim system activity.
verify: Reconcile the workbook milestone count against the claim activity count.
Pass when the two counts match.

steps.title: Clear unassigned milestones before plan approval
sop: Review the workbook and activity list for any milestone still unassigned.
Allocate an owner to each flagged milestone before approving the plan.
Done when the plan is approved with zero unassigned milestones.
verify: Re-run the blank owner filter on the approved plan version.
Pass when the approved version returns no unassigned milestones.

generic.Defined scope/population: All site and record access needed from the insured, claimant, tenants and public authorities.
generic.In-scope period: From access request through the confirmed inspection date and any reschedule.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Access record shows date, time, granting party, site safety notes and PPE requirements.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Each access point identified in the plan has a matching confirmation or refusal record.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Written access confirmations filed in the claim repository with send and receipt dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Access refusals and reschedules logged as contact attempts with the next action.
generic.Test population: Every site or record access required for the investigation.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: 100% of confirmed access arrangements evidenced in writing.
generic.Exception handling path: Repeated access refusal escalated to the Claims Adjuster for policy cooperation action.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Access accepted when the date, time and granting party are confirmed in writing on the file.
generic.Evidence location: Claim repository access correspondence folder and ClaimCenter contact log.

steps.title: List required access points from the plan in ClaimCenter
sop: Read the investigation plan and evidence catalogue on the claim in ClaimCenter.
List each site, record and third-party access needed for the inspection.
Done when all required access points are listed with the holding party.
verify: Check the list against the evidence sources catalogued on the claim.
Pass when every evidence source needing access appears on the list.

steps.title: Contact the insured or property owner to agree the site visit
sop: Call the insured or property owner and propose inspection dates and times.
Confirm the agreed slot by email or letter and file it in the claim repository.
Done when the site visit date and time are confirmed in writing.
verify: Open the filed confirmation and read the date, time and granting party.
Pass when all three appear on the written confirmation.

steps.title: Obtain third-party or tenant permission where the site is not insured-controlled
sop: Identify who legally controls entry where the insured does not occupy the site.
Request and obtain written permission from that party before attending.
Done when written permission from the controlling party is on file.
verify: Check the permission names the controlling party and the access date.
Pass when permission covers the planned attendance date.

steps.title: Request the public authority file and scene access
sop: Quote the police or fire incident report number in the access request.
Send the request to the issuing agency and diarise the expected response.
Done when the authority request is sent and diarised in ClaimCenter.
verify: Check the request records the incident report number and issuing agency.
Pass when both are present on the filed request.

steps.title: Record site safety and PPE requirements on the access note
sop: Ask the granting party about hazards, structural risk and restricted areas.
Record the hazards and required PPE in the access arrangement note.
Done when safety and PPE requirements are documented before attendance.
verify: Read the access note for hazard and PPE content.
Pass when the note names the hazards and the PPE required.

steps.title: Log refusals and reschedules as contact attempts in ClaimCenter
sop: Log every refused or rescheduled access with date, time and reason.
Set the next contact attempt or escalate where access is repeatedly refused.
Done when each refusal or reschedule has a logged next action.
verify: Review the contact log for refusals with no follow-up action.
Pass when every refusal shows a logged next action.

generic.Defined scope/population: The specialist need decision covering engineer, cause-and-origin and forensic accountant disciplines.
generic.In-scope period: From investigation planning through any later revisit when complexity changes.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Decision names the discipline or states none needed, with trigger, cost estimate and date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: One recorded specialist decision exists for each open causation or quantum issue.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Decision note filed on the claim with the decision date and any later revision.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Deferred or reversed specialist decisions logged with the reason and new outcome.
generic.Test population: All claims in the area where a specialist trigger is present on the file.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No file with a live trigger lacks a recorded specialist decision.
generic.Exception handling path: Cost above the adjuster authority routed to the Claims Examiner for budget approval.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Decision accepted when discipline, trigger, cost estimate and rationale are all recorded.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter claim notes and the specialist decision document in the claim repository.

steps.title: Review open fact issues on the claim in ClaimCenter
sop: Read the investigation plan open issues and the current evidence position.
Identify issues that cannot be resolved by adjuster investigation alone.
Done when unresolved technical issues are listed on the claim.
verify: Check each listed issue against the plan open questions.
Pass when every unresolved technical issue is captured.

steps.title: Test the file against the specialist trigger criteria
sop: Test for disputed causation, large-loss threshold breach and subrogation potential.
Record which trigger is present or confirm that none applies.
Done when the applicable trigger is named on the claim note.
verify: Compare the recorded trigger against the exposure and causation position.
Pass when the named trigger is supported by the file facts.

steps.title: Select the discipline required for the issue
sop: Match the unresolved issue to engineer, cause-and-origin or forensic accountant.
Where more than one discipline is needed, list each with its issue.
Done when each unresolved issue has a named discipline or an explicit none.
verify: Check each discipline choice maps to a named open issue.
Pass when no discipline is selected without a supporting issue.

steps.title: Capture the estimated specialist cost in the claim record
sop: Obtain an indicative fee range for the discipline from the vendor panel rates.
Record the estimated cost against the specialist decision on the claim.
Done when an estimated cost is recorded for each proposed retention.
verify: Check the estimate is present for every proposed specialist.
Pass when no proposed retention lacks a cost estimate.

steps.title: Obtain budget approval before retention
sop: Review the estimated cost against the exposure and the authority matrix.
Approve or decline the spend and record the decision on the claim.
Done when the retention spend is approved or declined in writing.
verify: Check the approval level against the authority matrix for the estimated fee.
Pass when approval was given at or above the required level.

steps.title: Record the decision and rationale in the claim file
sop: Write the decision note stating discipline or no specialist required, with rationale.
File the note in the claim repository and diarise a revisit if facts may change.
Done when the dated decision note is filed on the claim.
verify: Read the filed note for discipline, trigger, cost and rationale.
Pass when all four elements are present and the note is dated.

generic.Defined scope/population: The full investigation plan covering coverage, liability and damages questions for this loss.
generic.In-scope period: The five days following claim assignment in which the draft plan must be produced.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Plan states loss type, handling track, open issues, evidence sources, owners and dates.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Each open fact issue maps to exactly one evidence source and one owner.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Draft plan saved to the claim repository with a version number and draft date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Issues with no identified evidence source logged as gaps with the next action.
generic.Test population: All open coverage, liability and damages questions identified on the claim.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Draft plan dated within 5 days of claim assignment.
generic.Exception handling path: Plans slipping past 5 days escalated to the Claims Examiner with the delay reason.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Plan accepted when issues, evidence sources, owners, track and fraud steps are all present.
generic.Evidence location: Investigation plan document in the claim repository linked to the ClaimCenter claim.

steps.title: Read the FNOL and coverage position in ClaimCenter
sop: Read the FNOL narrative, loss type and the recorded coverage position.
Note the assignment date so the 5-day drafting deadline is fixed.
Done when loss facts and the drafting deadline are established.
verify: Check the noted deadline against the assignment date on the claim.
Pass when the deadline is 5 days or fewer from assignment.

steps.title: List coverage, liability and damages questions separately
sop: Create three separate question sections in the plan workbook in Excel.
Enter each open question under the correct section without mixing categories.
Done when every open question sits under one of the three sections.
verify: Review each section for questions that belong elsewhere.
Pass when no question is filed under the wrong category.

steps.title: Map each fact issue to an evidence source and owner
sop: For each open issue, name the evidence source that will resolve it.
Name the owner who will obtain that evidence and set a due date.
Done when every issue row shows a source, an owner and a date.
verify: Filter the plan rows for blank source, owner or date cells.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Set the handling track and record the reason
sop: Assess complexity, exposure and coverage doubt against the track criteria.
Record fast-track or complex protocol in the plan with the supporting reason.
Done when the handling track and its reason are stated in the plan.
verify: Check the chosen track against the exposure and complexity indicators.
Pass when the track matches the recorded criteria.

steps.title: Add fraud screening and subrogation steps as plan items
sop: Add a fraud red-flag screening item with an owner and a due date.
Add a subrogation evaluation item covering recovery potential against third parties.
Done when both items appear in the plan with owners and dates.
verify: Search the plan for the fraud screening and subrogation rows.
Pass when both rows exist with an owner and a date.

steps.title: Save the dated draft plan to the claim repository
sop: Save the draft with a version number and the draft date in the file name.
Attach it to the claim in ClaimCenter and route it to the examiner for review.
Done when the dated draft is attached to the claim and routed.
verify: Compare the draft date against the claim assignment date.
Pass when the draft is dated within 5 days of assignment.

generic.Defined scope/population: The approved investigation plan and its superseded drafts for this claim.
generic.In-scope period: From plan approval to the first milestone diary date set at filing.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Filed plan shows approver name, approval date, accountabilities and milestone deadlines.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Filed plan version count equals the number of drafts produced during planning.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Approved and superseded versions retained in the repository with version dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Plans filed without approval flagged and routed for retrospective sign-off.
generic.Test population: All approved investigation plans on claims in this area.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: 100% of approved plans attached to the claim rather than held in email.
generic.Exception handling path: Missing approver detail returned to the Claims Examiner before the plan is relied on.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Filing accepted when the attached plan shows approver, date, owners and deadlines.
generic.Evidence location: Claim repository investigation plan folder and the ClaimCenter document list.

steps.title: Obtain examiner approval on the draft plan
sop: Review the draft plan for issue coverage, owners and deadline realism.
Record approval with name and date on the plan document itself.
Done when the plan carries a named and dated approval.
verify: Read the approval block on the plan document.
Pass when approver name and approval date are both present.

steps.title: Attach the approved plan to the claim in ClaimCenter
sop: Upload the approved plan to the claim under the investigation plan document type.
Confirm the attachment opens from the claim document list.
Done when the approved plan is attached and opens from the claim.
verify: Open the document from the claim document list.
Pass when the attached file is the approved version.

steps.title: Confirm accountabilities and deadlines appear on the filed copy
sop: Read the filed copy and check every milestone shows an owner and a date.
Correct and refile if any accountability or deadline is missing.
Done when the filed copy shows owners and deadlines throughout.
verify: Scan the filed copy for milestones with blank owner or date.
Pass when no milestone on the filed copy is missing either.

steps.title: Set the diary to the first plan milestone date
sop: Identify the earliest milestone date on the approved plan.
Create a ClaimCenter diary entry for that date against the file owner.
Done when a diary entry exists for the first milestone.
verify: Compare the diary date against the earliest milestone date.
Pass when the two dates match.

steps.title: Retain superseded draft versions in the repository
sop: Move earlier drafts into the plan history folder rather than deleting them.
Confirm each retained draft keeps its original version and date.
Done when all superseded drafts are retained and dated.
verify: List the plan folder contents and check for missing version numbers.
Pass when the version sequence has no gaps.

steps.title: Note the filing on the claim and notify plan owners
sop: Add a claim note referencing the filed plan document identifier.
Notify each milestone owner that the approved plan is now live.
Done when the note is added and owners are notified in ClaimCenter.
verify: Check the note quotes the filed document identifier.
Pass when the identifier in the note matches the attached document.

generic.Defined scope/population: All physical, documentary, witness and electronic evidence sources for this loss.
generic.In-scope period: From investigation planning until each electronic source overwrite deadline expires.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each catalogued source shows type, location, current custodian and any overwrite deadline.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Catalogue entry count matches the sources named across FNOL, statements and reports.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Catalogue saved to the claim repository with the date it was last updated.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Sources that cannot be located logged with the enquiry made and the outcome.
generic.Test population: Every evidence source referenced anywhere on the claim file.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: All four source categories represented or explicitly recorded as not applicable.
generic.Exception handling path: Third-party held evidence escalated for a preservation letter before the overwrite date.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Catalogue accepted when each source has a custodian and a preservation action where needed.
generic.Evidence location: Evidence catalogue document in the claim repository linked to the ClaimCenter claim.

steps.title: Catalogue physical evidence at the loss site
sop: List damaged property, components and debris present at the loss site.
Record each item location and the party currently holding it.
Done when every physical item is listed with location and custodian.
verify: Compare the list against the inspection photographs on the claim.
Pass when each photographed item appears in the catalogue.

steps.title: Capture incident report numbers and issuing agencies
sop: Read the FNOL and party accounts for police, fire or incident report references.
Record each report number with the agency that issued it in ClaimCenter.
Done when every known report number and agency is recorded.
verify: Check each recorded number has a named issuing agency.
Pass when no report number is recorded without an agency.

steps.title: Build the witness list with contact details
sop: Extract witness names from the FNOL, incident report and party statements.
Record contact details for each witness in the evidence catalogue.
Done when every identified witness appears with contact details.
verify: Filter the witness entries for missing contact details.
Pass when no witness entry is missing a contact route.

steps.title: Identify electronic evidence and its overwrite deadline
sop: Identify telematics, EDR, CCTV and dashcam sources relevant to the loss.
Record the retention or overwrite deadline for each electronic source.
Done when each electronic source shows its overwrite deadline.
verify: Check the recorded deadlines against the holder retention policy noted.
Pass when every electronic source has a dated overwrite deadline.

steps.title: Run background checks on parties in LexisNexis Risk
sop: Search LexisNexis Risk for prior claims and related records for each party.
Add any documentary source found to the evidence catalogue.
Done when search results are reviewed and relevant sources catalogued.
verify: Check the catalogue reflects each relevant search hit.
Pass when no relevant search hit is missing from the catalogue.

steps.title: Issue preservation letters for third-party held evidence
sop: Draft a preservation letter for each source held by a third party.
Send before the overwrite deadline and file the sent copy on the claim.
Done when a preservation letter is sent for every third-party source.
verify: Compare each letter send date against the source overwrite deadline.
Pass when every letter was sent before its deadline.

generic.Defined scope/population: The FNOL narrative and the policy coverage position for the loss under review.
generic.In-scope period: The policy period in force on the date of loss including any endorsement dates.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Named insured, limits, deductible, endorsements and cause of loss all recorded on the claim.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Claim policy details match the declarations page in the policy administration system.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Declarations page and coverage note filed on the claim with the review date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unresolved coverage questions logged into the investigation plan as work items.
generic.Test population: Every new loss assigned for investigation in the area.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Policy confirmed in force on the date of loss before investigation scope is set.
generic.Exception handling path: Coverage doubt routed to the Claims Examiner for a reservation of rights decision.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Review accepted when in-force status, limits, deductible and exclusions tested are documented.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter coverage note and the declarations page filed in the claim repository.

steps.title: Read the FNOL narrative on the claim in ClaimCenter
sop: Read the FNOL loss description, date, time, location and reported cause.
Note the facts that will drive coverage and liability questions.
Done when the reported loss facts are summarised on the claim.
verify: Compare the summary against the FNOL record fields.
Pass when the summary matches the FNOL loss facts.

steps.title: Confirm the policy was in force on the date of loss
sop: Open the policy in the policy administration system and read the term dates.
Confirm the date of loss falls within the in-force term with no lapse.
Done when in-force status on the loss date is confirmed and noted.
verify: Re-check the loss date against the policy effective and expiry dates.
Pass when the loss date sits inside the in-force term.

steps.title: Read limits, deductible and endorsements from the declarations page
sop: Open the declarations page and record named insured, limits and deductible.
List every endorsement attached to the policy term.
Done when limits, deductible and the endorsement list are recorded on the claim.
verify: Compare the claim record values against the declarations page.
Pass when the recorded values match the declarations page.

steps.title: Test the reported cause against exclusions and conditions
sop: Read the policy form exclusions and conditions relevant to the reported cause.
Record which exclusions and conditions were considered and the outcome.
Done when the exclusion and condition test is documented on the claim.
verify: Check the note names the specific exclusions considered.
Pass when each considered exclusion has a recorded outcome.

steps.title: Assess the need for a reservation of rights
sop: Assess whether any coverage question remains unresolved after the review.
Record the reservation of rights decision with the supporting reason.
Done when the reservation of rights decision is documented.
verify: Check the decision addresses each unresolved coverage question.
Pass when no open coverage question is left without a decision.

steps.title: Write unresolved coverage questions into the investigation plan
sop: Transfer each unresolved coverage question into the plan as a work item.
Assign an owner and a due date to each transferred item.
Done when every open coverage question is a dated plan work item.
verify: Reconcile the coverage note questions against the plan work items.
Pass when every question appears as a plan item with an owner.

generic.Defined scope/population: The fraud red-flag screen covering the insured, claimants and treating providers on this loss.
generic.In-scope period: The early investigation window from claim assignment to the first evaluation.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Every red-flag checklist item answered with a screen date and a recorded outcome.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Parties screened equal the parties listed on the claim as insured, claimant or provider.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Completed checklist and search results filed on the claim with the screen date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Triggered indicators logged with the SIU referral date and referral outcome.
generic.Test population: All new losses assigned for investigation in the area.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Any triggered indicator referred to SIU within 48 hours of the screen.
generic.Exception handling path: Triggered indicators referred to the SIU Field Investigator with the checklist attached.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Screen accepted when every checklist item is answered and the outcome is explicit.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter red-flag checklist screen and the LexisNexis search results on the claim.

steps.title: Open the red-flag checklist on the claim in ClaimCenter
sop: Open the fraud red-flag checklist against the claim in ClaimCenter.
Answer every checklist item rather than leaving items blank.
Done when all checklist items carry an answer.
verify: Scan the checklist for unanswered items.
Pass when no checklist item is left blank.

steps.title: Run prior-loss and claim history searches in LexisNexis Risk
sop: Search the insured, each claimant and treating providers in LexisNexis Risk.
Attach the search results to the claim and note any adverse history.
Done when all three party categories have been searched and filed.
verify: Compare parties searched against the party list on the claim.
Pass when every claim party has a filed search result.

steps.title: Check loss date proximity to policy events
sop: Compare the loss date against inception, reinstatement and limit-increase dates.
Record the interval found and whether it breaches the proximity threshold.
Done when the proximity check result is recorded on the claim.
verify: Recompute the interval from the policy administration system dates.
Pass when the recorded interval matches the policy dates.

steps.title: Refer triggered indicators to SIU within 48 hours
sop: Accept the referral where any indicator triggered and log the receipt date.
Confirm the completed checklist is attached to the referral.
Done when the referral is logged with the checklist attached.
verify: Compare the referral date against the screen completion date.
Pass when the referral was made within 48 hours of the screen.

steps.title: Record a clean screen result explicitly
sop: Where no indicator triggered, record a clean result rather than leaving it blank.
State the screen date and the searches relied on in the claim note.
Done when a clean outcome is explicitly recorded with its date.
verify: Open the claim note and read the recorded outcome.
Pass when the outcome is stated explicitly and dated.

steps.title: Confirm the screen outcome before the investigation proceeds
sop: Review the completed checklist, searches and referral status.
Confirm the outcome or direct further screening before evaluation continues.
Done when the examiner records confirmation of the screen outcome.
verify: Check the confirmation note against the checklist outcome.
Pass when the confirmation matches the recorded screen result.

generic.Defined scope/population: All investigation milestones requiring a dated deadline on this claim.
generic.In-scope period: From claim assignment to the reserve review date at the end of the investigation.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each milestone shows a calendar date, an owner and a matching diary reminder.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Milestone count in the timeline equals the diary reminder count in ClaimCenter.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Timeline workbook saved to the claim repository with its version date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Milestones missed or moved logged with the reason and the revised date.
generic.Test population: Every dated milestone on the current investigation timeline.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Statement milestones within 14 days and scene milestones within 72 hours.
generic.Exception handling path: Timeline breaching the cycle-time target escalated to the Claims Examiner.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Timeline accepted when every milestone has a calendar date and a diary reminder.
generic.Evidence location: Timeline tab of the plan workbook and the ClaimCenter diary entries.

steps.title: List investigation milestones in the Excel timeline tab
sop: Open the plan workbook in Microsoft Excel and go to the timeline tab.
List each milestone from evidence collection through evaluation and reserve review.
Done when all milestones are listed on the timeline tab.
verify: Compare the timeline list against the plan milestone list.
Pass when the two lists contain the same milestones.

steps.title: Assign a calendar date to each milestone
sop: Convert every relative duration into a specific calendar date.
Remove any milestone entry left as a duration rather than a date.
Done when every milestone carries a calendar date.
verify: Filter the date column for non-date values.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Apply the statement and scene timing standards
sop: Set statement milestones inside the 14-day standard from party identification.
Set property scene inspection milestones inside the 72-hour standard.
Done when both standards are reflected in the milestone dates.
verify: Measure each statement and scene milestone against its standard.
Pass when no milestone breaches its standard without a recorded reason.

steps.title: Sequence expert and evaluation milestones before reserve review
sop: Order expert report, evaluation and reserve review milestones in that sequence.
Adjust dates so no evaluation input falls after the reserve review date.
Done when the sequence places all inputs before reserve review.
verify: Sort the timeline by date and read the milestone order.
Pass when reserve review is the last milestone in the sequence.

steps.title: Create diary reminders in ClaimCenter for every milestone
sop: Create one ClaimCenter diary entry per dated milestone against its owner.
Set the diary date equal to the milestone date on the timeline.
Done when every milestone has a matching diary entry.
verify: Reconcile the diary entry count against the milestone count.
Pass when the counts match and dates align.

steps.title: Check the timeline against the line of business cycle-time target
sop: Compare the final milestone date against the cycle-time target for the line.
Approve the timeline or require compression where the target is breached.
Done when the timeline is approved or compressed to target.
verify: Measure the elapsed days from assignment to the final milestone.
Pass when elapsed days sit within the cycle-time target.

generic.Defined scope/population: All plan revisions triggered by material new facts developed during the investigation.
generic.In-scope period: From plan approval until the investigation closes and the evaluation is finalised.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each revision shows version number, revision date, new facts and the resulting plan changes.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Retained plan version count equals the number of material fact events logged.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Every plan version retained in the claim repository with its version date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Closed lines of enquiry marked complete with the finding recorded.
generic.Test population: All claims where material new facts were developed after plan approval.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: More than one dated plan version exists where new facts were developed.
generic.Exception handling path: Reserve-moving facts escalated to the Claims Examiner in the same plan update.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Revision accepted when new sources, owners, dates and reserve impact are all recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Plan version history folder in the claim repository and ClaimCenter claim notes.

steps.title: Review new facts logged on the claim in ClaimCenter
sop: Read claim notes, statements and reports received since the last plan version.
Identify which new facts are material to coverage, liability or damages.
Done when material new facts are listed for plan revision.
verify: Check each listed fact against its source document on the claim.
Pass when every listed fact is evidenced by a filed document.

steps.title: Increment the plan version in the claim repository
sop: Copy the current plan to a new version number with today's date.
Leave the previous version untouched in the version history folder.
Done when a new dated plan version exists alongside the prior one.
verify: List the plan folder and read the version sequence.
Pass when the new version is present and the prior version is retained.

steps.title: Mark closed lines of enquiry complete with findings
sop: Mark each resolved enquiry as complete in the new plan version.
Record the finding that closed the enquiry against that line.
Done when every closed enquiry shows its finding.
verify: Filter completed enquiries for blank finding cells.
Pass when no completed enquiry lacks a recorded finding.

steps.title: Add newly identified evidence sources with owner and date
sop: Add each new evidence source raised by the new facts to the plan.
Assign an owner and a due date to each added source.
Done when every added source has an owner and a due date.
verify: Filter added rows for blank owner or due date.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Flag the reserve impact to the file owner
sop: Assess whether the new facts move exposure up or down.
Record the reserve impact in the same update and notify the file owner.
Done when the reserve impact is recorded and notified.
verify: Check the update contains an explicit reserve impact statement.
Pass when the statement is present and the file owner was notified.

steps.title: Approve the revised plan and reset diaries
sop: Review the revised plan for completeness against the new facts.
Approve it and confirm diaries match the revised milestone dates.
Done when the revised plan is approved and diaries are reset.
verify: Compare ClaimCenter diary dates against the revised milestone dates.
Pass when every revised milestone has a matching diary entry.

generic.Defined scope/population: All recorded statement audio files and transcripts taken on this claim.
generic.In-scope period: From statement capture until the retention period for the line of business expires.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each archived item shows party name, role, statement date, document type and retention class.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Archived audio count equals archived transcript count and the statements taken count.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Audio and transcript stored in the repository with upload timestamps retained.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Failed or truncated uploads logged with the re-upload action and outcome.
generic.Test population: Every recorded statement taken on claims in this area.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: 100% of statements archived with both audio and transcript present.
generic.Exception handling path: Missing audio or transcript escalated to the Claims Adjuster who took the statement.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Archive accepted when playback is complete and the retention class is applied.
generic.Evidence location: OpenText Document Mgmt recorded-statement library linked to the ClaimCenter claim.

steps.title: Collect audio files and transcripts for the claim
sop: List every statement taken on the claim from the investigation tracker.
Gather the audio file and matching transcript for each listed statement.
Done when audio and transcript are held for every statement taken.
verify: Compare the gathered pairs against the tracker statement list.
Pass when no statement on the tracker lacks a pair.

steps.title: Name files with party, role and statement date
sop: Rename each file to show party name, role and the statement date.
Use the same naming for the audio and its transcript.
Done when every file name shows party, role and date.
verify: Read the file names in the repository listing.
Pass when all three elements appear in every file name.

steps.title: Upload under the recorded-statement document type in OpenText
sop: Upload the audio and transcript to OpenText Document Mgmt for the claim.
Set the document type to recorded statement on both items.
Done when both items are uploaded under the correct document type.
verify: Filter the claim documents by recorded-statement type.
Pass when both items appear under that type.

steps.title: Apply the retention class for the line and jurisdiction
sop: Determine the retention period for the line of business and loss jurisdiction.
Apply the matching retention class to each archived item.
Done when every archived item carries a retention class.
verify: Check the applied class against the retention schedule for the jurisdiction.
Pass when the applied class matches the schedule.

steps.title: Play the archived recording end to end
sop: Open the archived recording from OpenText and play it to the end.
Log any truncation or corruption and re-upload from source if found.
Done when the archived recording plays through without truncation.
verify: Compare playback duration against the duration logged at capture.
Pass when the durations match.

steps.title: Delete local and handheld copies after successful upload
sop: Confirm the archived copy is retrievable from the claim in ClaimCenter.
Delete the recording from the handheld device and any local drive.
Done when only the archived copy remains.
verify: Check the device and local folder for remaining statement files.
Pass when no local or handheld copy remains.

generic.Defined scope/population: All statements taken on the claim compared against scene evidence and each other.
generic.In-scope period: From the first statement taken until the liability determination is finalised.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each discrepancy shows the accounts compared and the transcript page or timestamp.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Statements assessed equal the statements filed on the claim record.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Consistency note filed on the claim with the assessment date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Material inconsistencies logged with the red-flag test result and any SIU referral.
generic.Test population: Every filed statement on the claim including insured, claimant and witnesses.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every material discrepancy cited to a transcript page or recording timestamp.
generic.Exception handling path: Triggered red-flag inconsistencies referred to SIU and noted on the claim.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Assessment accepted when each statement is compared to photographs and to other accounts.
generic.Evidence location: Consistency note in ClaimCenter and the statement documents in the claim repository.

steps.title: Assemble statements and scene photographs from the claim file
sop: Open the claim repository and list all filed statements and scene photographs.
Confirm every party on the statement list has a filed statement.
Done when statements and photographs are assembled for comparison.
verify: Compare the assembled set against the statement tracker.
Pass when no taken statement is missing from the set.

steps.title: Compare each statement against the observed damage pattern
sop: Read each account of the impact or damage mechanism in turn.
Compare it against the damage pattern shown in the scene photographs.
Done when each statement has been tested against the photographs.
verify: Check that each statement has a recorded photograph comparison.
Pass when no statement is left untested against the photographs.

steps.title: Compare point of impact and event sequence across accounts
sop: Lay the insured, claimant and witness sequences side by side.
Mark where the accounts diverge on impact point or sequence.
Done when divergence points across the accounts are identified.
verify: Check each divergence names the accounts that conflict.
Pass when every divergence identifies the conflicting parties.

steps.title: Cite each discrepancy to a transcript page or timestamp
sop: For each discrepancy, locate the supporting passage in the transcript or recording.
Record the transcript page number or the recording timestamp beside it.
Done when every discrepancy carries a citation.
verify: Open two cited references and confirm they contain the quoted content.
Pass when the cited references match the recorded discrepancy.

steps.title: Test material inconsistencies against the red-flag checklist
sop: Test each material inconsistency against the fraud red-flag indicators.
Refer to SIU where an indicator triggers and record the referral.
Done when every material inconsistency has been red-flag tested.
verify: Check the checklist result recorded against each material inconsistency.
Pass when every material inconsistency has a recorded test result.

steps.title: Write the consistency findings into a claim note
sop: Write the findings, discrepancies and citations into a ClaimCenter note.
State the effect of the findings on the liability position.
Done when the dated consistency note is saved on the claim.
verify: Read the note for discrepancies, citations and the liability effect.
Pass when all three appear in the filed note.

generic.Defined scope/population: All recorded statement media requiring authentication before filing on the claim.
generic.In-scope period: From the moment the recording is captured or received until it is filed.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Authentication note shows consent preamble, deponent identity, duration and integrity result.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Recording duration reconciles against the transcript length for each statement.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Authenticated media filed with capture timestamp and any chain of custody note.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Gaps, overwrites or dropouts logged with the remediation action taken.
generic.Test population: Every recorded statement media file on the claim.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: 100% of filed recordings carry a consent preamble and an integrity check result.
generic.Exception handling path: Media failing the integrity check escalated to the Claims Adjuster for retaking.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Media accepted when consent, identity, duration and integrity are all confirmed.
generic.Evidence location: Authentication note in ClaimCenter and the media file in the claim repository.

steps.title: Play the opening of the recording for the consent preamble
sop: Play the first minutes of the recording from the claim repository.
Confirm date, time, parties present and consent to record are stated.
Done when the consent preamble content is confirmed.
verify: Re-play the preamble and check all four elements are audible.
Pass when date, time, parties and consent are all present.

steps.title: Confirm the deponent states name and address on the recording
sop: Listen for the deponent stating their full name and address.
Compare the stated details against the party record in ClaimCenter.
Done when identity is confirmed against the claim party record.
verify: Match the spoken name and address against the ClaimCenter party record.
Pass when the spoken details match the party record.

steps.title: Check the recording for gaps, overwrites and dropouts
sop: Play the recording through and note any silence, cut or overwrite.
Log each anomaly with its timestamp on the authentication note.
Done when the full recording has been checked for anomalies.
verify: Check that any anomaly found is logged with a timestamp.
Pass when the integrity check result is recorded either way.

steps.title: Reconcile recording duration against transcript length
sop: Record the media duration and the last timestamp in the transcript.
Compare the two and investigate any material difference.
Done when duration and transcript length are reconciled.
verify: Compare the two figures on the authentication note.
Pass when the difference is explained or nil.

steps.title: Add a chain of custody note for third-party media
sop: Record who supplied the media, when it was received and in what format.
Attach any transmittal correspondence to the claim repository.
Done when custody is documented for all third-party sourced media.
verify: Check the custody note names the supplier and receipt date.
Pass when both appear for every third-party media item.

steps.title: File the authentication note on the claim in ClaimCenter
sop: Write the authentication note covering consent, identity, duration and integrity.
Attach the note to the same claim activity as the media file.
Done when the authentication note is filed against the media.
verify: Open the media activity and read the attached authentication note.
Pass when the note is present and covers all four elements.

generic.Defined scope/population: Recorded statements from every party on the statement-required list for this claim.
generic.In-scope period: Within 14 days of each party being identified as requiring a statement.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each statement records consent, deponent identity, loss sequence, injuries and damages.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Statements taken plus documented declines equal the parties on the required list.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Recording filed with capture date and duration logged on the claim the same day.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Parties declining or unreachable logged with the contact attempts made.
generic.Test population: All parties listed as requiring a recorded statement on the claim.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Statement taken within 14 days of the party being identified.
generic.Exception handling path: Statements slipping past 14 days escalated to the Liability Claims Specialist.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Statement accepted when the full outline is covered and closing correction is offered.
generic.Evidence location: Recorded statement media and log entry on the ClaimCenter claim activity.

steps.title: Confirm the session details on the claim in ClaimCenter
sop: Open the scheduled statement activity and confirm party, date and time.
Check the identification date so the 14-day standard can be measured.
Done when session details and the 14-day deadline are confirmed.
verify: Compare the session date against the party identification date.
Pass when the session falls inside the 14-day window.

steps.title: Obtain consent to record before substantive questioning
sop: Start the recording and state date, time and parties present.
Ask the deponent to confirm consent to be recorded on the recording.
Done when consent is captured before any substantive question is asked.
verify: Play back the opening of the recording.
Pass when consent precedes the first substantive question.

steps.title: Work through the pre-loss and loss sequence questions
sop: Follow the prepared outline through pre-loss facts and the loss sequence.
Use open questions for narrative and closed questions to confirm detail.
Done when pre-loss and loss sequence sections are fully covered.
verify: Check the outline sections against the recording content.
Pass when no outline section in this part is unaddressed.

steps.title: Cover injuries, damages and prior conditions
sop: Question on injuries claimed, treatment to date and property damage claimed.
Ask about prior injuries or damage to the same body part or property.
Done when injury, damages and prior-condition questions are all answered.
verify: Check the recording for answers on each of the three topics.
Pass when all three topics have recorded answers.

steps.title: Offer the deponent the chance to add or correct
sop: Before closing, ask the deponent to add or correct anything stated.
Record any addition or correction on the same recording.
Done when the closing invitation and any response are recorded.
verify: Play back the closing section of the recording.
Pass when the invitation to add or correct is audible.

steps.title: Log completion and duration on the claim the same day
sop: Update the ClaimCenter activity with completion status and duration.
Note any party who declined and the attempts made.
Done when the completion log is entered on the day of the statement.
verify: Compare the log entry date against the statement date.
Pass when both dates are the same.

generic.Defined scope/population: Verbatim transcripts for every recorded statement held on the claim.
generic.In-scope period: From receipt of the recording until the transcript is attached to the claim activity.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Transcript shows party details, statement date, speaker labels and timestamped inaudibles.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Transcript count equals the recorded statement count on the claim.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Transcript stored with its version and the source recording reference.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Inaudible passages logged with timestamps rather than paraphrased.
generic.Test population: Every recorded statement on claims in this area.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No transcript summarised rather than verbatim.
generic.Exception handling path: Poor audio quality escalated to the Claims Adjuster who took the statement.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Transcript accepted when verbatim, speaker-labelled and paired with its recording.
generic.Evidence location: OpenText Document Mgmt transcript record on the ClaimCenter statement activity.

steps.title: Retrieve the source recording from the claim repository
sop: Open the statement activity in ClaimCenter and download the source recording.
Note the party name, role and statement date from the activity.
Done when the recording and its party details are in hand.
verify: Compare the recording details against the statement activity record.
Pass when party and date on the recording match the activity.

steps.title: Transcribe the recording word for word
sop: Transcribe every word including hesitations and self-corrections.
Do not summarise, tidy or omit any spoken content.
Done when the whole recording is transcribed verbatim.
verify: Spot-check three passages against the recording.
Pass when the checked passages match word for word.

steps.title: Label speakers by name and role throughout
sop: Insert a speaker label before every change of speaker.
Use the party name and role rather than generic speaker numbers.
Done when every speaker turn carries a named label.
verify: Scan the transcript for unlabelled speaker turns.
Pass when no turn lacks a named label.

steps.title: Mark inaudible passages with timestamps
sop: Insert an inaudible marker with the recording timestamp where speech is unclear.
Do not guess or paraphrase unclear content.
Done when every unclear passage is marked with a timestamp.
verify: Check each inaudible marker carries a timestamp.
Pass when no marker is left without a timestamp.

steps.title: Check transcript header details against the recording
sop: Compare the transcript party name, role and date against the recording preamble.
Correct any mismatch before the transcript is filed.
Done when header details match the source recording.
verify: Re-read the preamble and the transcript header.
Pass when the details are identical.

steps.title: Attach the transcript to the statement activity in OpenText
sop: Upload the transcript to OpenText Document Mgmt against the claim.
Attach it to the same claim activity that holds the audio file.
Done when audio and transcript sit on the same activity.
verify: Open the statement activity and list its attachments.
Pass when both audio and transcript appear on that activity.

generic.Defined scope/population: All witnesses identified on the claim from FNOL, reports and party statements.
generic.In-scope period: From witness identification until the witness is interviewed or closed as unreachable.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each entry shows name, phone, address, relationship, observation and availability.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Log entry count equals the witnesses named across FNOL, report and statements.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Investigation log saved with its update date and contact attempt timestamps.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unreachable witnesses logged with each attempt date, time and outcome.
generic.Test population: Every witness identified anywhere on the claim file.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No witness entry missing contact details or an observation summary.
generic.Exception handling path: Witnesses with no contact route escalated to the Field Claims Adjuster for tracing.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Entry accepted when contact, relationship, observation and availability are all present.
generic.Evidence location: Witness tab of the investigation log in Excel and the ClaimCenter contact log.

steps.title: Extract witness names from the claim documents
sop: Read the FNOL, incident report and filed statements for witness references.
List every named witness including passengers and bystanders.
Done when all referenced witnesses are listed.
verify: Cross-check the list against the incident report witness section.
Pass when every report witness appears on the list.

steps.title: Record contact details in the Excel investigation log
sop: Enter full name, phone, address and email for each witness in the log.
Leave a note where a detail is genuinely unavailable rather than blank.
Done when every witness row shows a usable contact route.
verify: Filter the log for rows with no phone, address or email.
Pass when every remaining row carries an explanatory note.

steps.title: Record each witness relationship to the parties
sop: Establish whether the witness is independent, family or an employee.
Record the relationship in the log against the witness.
Done when every witness shows a recorded relationship.
verify: Filter the relationship column for blanks.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Capture a one-line observation summary per witness
sop: Ask each witness what they saw and summarise it in one line.
Enter the summary in the log against the witness.
Done when every witness row shows an observation summary.
verify: Filter the observation column for blanks.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Record availability and preferred contact window
sop: Ask each witness when they can be contacted and by what channel.
Record the availability window in the log.
Done when availability is recorded for every contactable witness.
verify: Check availability entries against the contact attempts logged.
Pass when attempts fall inside the recorded windows.

steps.title: Log every contact attempt with date, time and outcome
sop: Record each call, message or visit against the witness in ClaimCenter.
State the outcome and the next planned attempt.
Done when every attempt is logged with an outcome.
verify: Review the contact log for attempts with no outcome recorded.
Pass when every logged attempt shows an outcome.

generic.Defined scope/population: All captured statements requiring filing into the claim investigation record.
generic.In-scope period: The 24 hours following completion of each statement.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each filed statement shows the correct party, document type and document identifier.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Filed statement count equals the statements marked taken on the tracker.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Filed documents retain their upload timestamp on the ClaimCenter claim.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Statements found only in email or on local drives logged and refiled.
generic.Test population: Every statement taken on claims in this area.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Filing completed within 24 hours of the statement being taken.
generic.Exception handling path: Late filings escalated to the Claims Adjuster with the delay reason recorded.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Filing accepted when party, document type and cross-reference note are all correct.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter claim document list and the claim repository statement folder.

steps.title: Identify the correct claimant party in ClaimCenter
sop: Open the claim party list and identify the party the statement belongs to.
On multi-claimant claims confirm the party by name before filing.
Done when the target party is confirmed for the statement.
verify: Compare the statement deponent name against the selected party.
Pass when the names match.

steps.title: Upload the statement under the recorded statement document type
sop: Upload the statement document to the claim in ClaimCenter.
Set the document type to recorded statement so it surfaces in file review.
Done when the statement is uploaded with the correct type.
verify: Filter claim documents by recorded statement type.
Pass when the uploaded statement appears in the filtered list.

steps.title: File the statement against the correct party record
sop: Link the uploaded document to the confirmed claimant party.
Correct any document filed against the wrong party.
Done when the statement is linked to the correct party.
verify: Open the party record and list its documents.
Pass when the statement appears under the correct party.

steps.title: Complete filing within 24 hours of the statement
sop: Compare the upload timestamp against the statement completion time.
Where filing is late, record the reason on the claim.
Done when filing is complete and any delay is explained.
verify: Measure elapsed hours between statement and upload.
Pass when elapsed hours are 24 or fewer or a reason is recorded.

steps.title: Add a claim note cross-referencing the document identifier
sop: Copy the document identifier from the claim document list.
Write a claim note quoting the identifier and the statement date.
Done when the note quotes the filed document identifier.
verify: Compare the identifier in the note against the document list.
Pass when the identifiers match.

steps.title: Remove statements held only in email or local drives
sop: Check the mailbox and local folders for statement copies not on the claim.
File any found copy on the claim and remove the local version.
Done when no statement exists outside the claim record.
verify: Re-search the mailbox and local folder for statement files.
Pass when the search returns no unfiled statement.

generic.Defined scope/population: Insured, every named claimant and each independent witness on this loss.
generic.In-scope period: From claim setup until the last party is identified during the investigation.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each listed party shows representation status, accommodation need and priority order.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Party list reconciles to the occupants and witnesses named in the police report.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Party list saved on the claim with the date it was last reconciled.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Parties excluded from statement requirement logged with the reason.
generic.Test population: All parties named anywhere on the claim or the incident report.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: List covers insured, all claimants and all identified witnesses.
generic.Exception handling path: Represented parties routed through counsel rather than contacted directly.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: List accepted when representation, accommodation and priority are recorded for each party.
generic.Evidence location: Statement-required party list on the ClaimCenter claim and the policy party record.

steps.title: List the insured and named claimants from ClaimCenter
sop: Open the claim party list and record the insured and every named claimant.
Check the policy administration system for additional named insureds.
Done when insured and claimants are listed separately.
verify: Compare the list against the claim and policy party records.
Pass when every named party appears on the list.

steps.title: Add independent witnesses to the list
sop: Add each independent witness identified in the investigation log.
Record the witness relationship so independence is visible.
Done when all independent witnesses are on the list.
verify: Compare the list against the witness investigation log.
Pass when no logged witness is missing from the list.

steps.title: Flag represented parties for routing through counsel
sop: Identify parties who have notified representation on the claim.
Flag those parties so contact routes through counsel not direct.
Done when every represented party carries the routing flag.
verify: Check each representation notice on the claim against the flags.
Pass when every notified representation is flagged.

steps.title: Identify interpreter, guardian and estate representative needs
sop: Identify parties who are minors, deceased or need language support.
Record the interpreter, guardian or estate representative required.
Done when accommodation needs are recorded against those parties.
verify: Check each minor or deceased party has a representative recorded.
Pass when no such party is left without a representative.

steps.title: Set the priority order by evidence value and memory decay
sop: Rank the parties by evidential value and by risk of memory decay.
Record the priority order against each party on the list.
Done when every party carries a priority ranking.
verify: Check the ranking places time-critical witnesses first.
Pass when no time-critical witness is ranked below routine parties.

steps.title: Reconcile the list against the police report
sop: Read the occupants and witnesses named in the police report.
Add any party named in the report but missing from the list.
Done when the list reconciles to the police report parties.
verify: Compare the report party names against the list one by one.
Pass when every report party is on the list or excluded with a reason.

generic.Defined scope/population: Written statements and examinations under oath required by policy conditions on this claim.
generic.In-scope period: From the demand being issued until the examination is held or non-appearance is documented.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Demand states policy section, notice period, date, time, place and documents to produce.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Demands issued equal the parties identified as requiring an examination.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Demand letter and proof of service filed on the claim with send dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Failure to appear or produce documented in writing with the follow-up decision.
generic.Test population: All claims where a policy condition supports an examination under oath.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every demand cites the policy condition by section number.
generic.Exception handling path: Coverage action following non-appearance routed to the Claims Examiner and counsel.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Demand accepted when condition, notice, logistics and document list are all stated.
generic.Evidence location: EUO demand letter and proof of service filed in the claim repository.

steps.title: Identify the policy condition permitting the examination
sop: Read the policy form conditions covering examination under oath and production.
Record the section number and wording that supports the demand.
Done when the supporting condition and section number are recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded section against the policy form text.
Pass when the cited section supports an examination on these facts.

steps.title: Draft the demand with notice, date, time and place
sop: Draft the demand stating date, time and place of the examination.
Apply the notice period required by the policy and state law.
Done when the demand states logistics and gives reasonable notice.
verify: Measure notice days between issue and examination date.
Pass when notice meets or exceeds the required period.

steps.title: Itemise the documents to be produced
sop: List each document category required at the examination.
Include the itemised list in the demand rather than a general request.
Done when the demand carries an itemised production list.
verify: Read the demand for an itemised rather than general list.
Pass when each required category is separately itemised.

steps.title: Arrange the court reporter and coverage counsel
sop: Book a court reporter for the examination date and confirm attendance.
Retain coverage counsel to conduct the examination under oath.
Done when reporter and counsel are booked and confirmed.
verify: Check the confirmations against the examination date.
Pass when both confirmations cover the examination date.

steps.title: Serve the demand and retain proof of delivery
sop: Serve the demand by the method the policy or statute requires.
File the proof of delivery or send receipt on the claim.
Done when the demand is served and proof is filed.
verify: Open the filed proof and read the service date.
Pass when service predates the examination by the required notice.

steps.title: Document any failure to appear or produce in writing
sop: Record non-appearance or non-production with date and circumstances.
Take no coverage action until the failure is documented on the claim.
Done when the failure is documented before any coverage step.
verify: Check the coverage action date against the documentation date.
Pass when documentation precedes any coverage action.

generic.Defined scope/population: The question outline covering coverage, liability, injury and damages issues for the statement.
generic.In-scope period: From plan approval until the statement session begins.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Outline shows issue sections, open facts targeted and prior-condition questions.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Every open fact in the investigation plan maps to at least one outline question.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Outline saved in the claim repository dated before the statement session.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Open facts with no viable question logged with the alternative evidence route.
generic.Test population: All open fact issues listed on the current investigation plan.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Outline dated before the statement session date.
generic.Exception handling path: Gaps in the outline escalated to the Liability Claims Specialist before the session.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Outline accepted when issue-structured, plan-linked and red-flag tested.
generic.Evidence location: Question outline document in the claim repository linked to the statement activity.

steps.title: Create issue sections in the outline workbook in Excel
sop: Open a new outline workbook in Microsoft Excel for this statement.
Create separate sections for coverage, liability, injury and damages.
Done when all four issue sections exist in the outline.
verify: Read the section headings in the workbook.
Pass when all four sections are present.

steps.title: Map plan open facts to outline questions
sop: Read the open facts listed in the investigation plan.
Write at least one question targeting each open fact into the right section.
Done when every open fact is covered by a question.
verify: Cross-check the plan open facts against the outline questions.

Log a chase and set a new date where the report has not arrived.

steps.title: Check the report is signed and dated by the credentialed expert

steps.title: Check every assignment question is answered

Tick each question against the report section that answers it.

steps.title: Confirm referenced photographs, data and appendices are attached
sop: List every appendix, photograph and test dataset referenced in the report.
Confirm each referenced item is actually attached.

Pass when the referenced items open from the claim.

steps.title: Reconcile the invoice against the approved fee estimate
sop: Compare the invoiced amount against the approved fee estimate.
Query any excess with the expert before authorising payment.
Done when the invoice is reconciled or queried.

Pass when the totals match or a query is logged.

steps.title: Record report receipt and close the assignment activity
sop: Record the receipt date against the expert assignment activity.
Close the activity once the report and invoice are accepted.
Done when the assignment activity is closed with a receipt date.

Pass when the receipt date is recorded on closure.

generic.Defined scope/population: The assignment package of loss facts, access authorisation and scope for the retained expert.

generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Assignment letter and transmittal filed with the send date on the claim.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Destructive testing requests logged and approved before any test is performed.
generic.Test population: All expert retentions on claims in this area.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every assignment letter states a fee cap and a report-back date.
generic.Exception handling path: Scope expansion requests routed back to the Claims Adjuster before work proceeds.

steps.title: Draft the assignment letter with the questions to answer
sop: Write the specific questions the expert must answer for this loss.
Avoid general instructions in favour of numbered questions.

Pass when every open issue is covered by a question.

steps.title: Assemble loss facts, FNOL, photographs and statements

List the enclosed items in the assignment letter enclosure list.
Done when the material is assembled and listed.
verify: Compare the enclosure list against the attached documents.
Pass when the list and attachments match.

steps.title: Include site-access authorisation and the on-site contact
sop: Attach the site-access authorisation obtained from the controlling party.
State the on-site contact name and phone number in the letter.
Done when access authorisation and contact are included.
verify: Read the letter for the authorisation reference and contact details.
Pass when both appear.

steps.title: State scope limits and the destructive testing bar
sop: State the matters the expert must not opine on.
State that destructive testing requires prior written approval.
Done when both scope limits appear in the letter.
verify: Read the letter for the scope limitation wording.
Pass when both limits are stated.

steps.title: State the fee cap and report-back date
sop: Enter the approved fee cap for the assignment in the letter.
Enter the agreed report-back date and diarise it in ClaimCenter.
Done when fee cap and date are stated and diarised.
verify: Compare the diary entry against the letter report-back date.
Pass when the dates match.

steps.title: Send the assignment and confirm expert receipt
sop: Send the letter and enclosures to the retained expert.
Obtain and file confirmation that the expert received the package.
Done when receipt confirmation is filed on the claim.
verify: Open the filed confirmation and read the receipt date.
Pass when receipt is confirmed in writing.
