Pass when panel status is confirmed.

steps.title: Verify licence, credentials and indemnity cover
sop: Request current licence, credentials and professional indemnity evidence.
File the evidence against the vendor record on the claim.
Done when all three items are evidenced and filed.
verify: Read the filed evidence for current expiry dates.
Pass when all three remain current at the assignment date.

steps.title: Run the conflict check against all parties
sop: Check the expert against the insured, claimant and opposing parties.
Record the conflict check result on the claim.
Done when the conflict result is recorded before retention.
verify: Compare the parties checked against the claim party list.
Pass when every claim party was checked.

steps.title: Obtain approval at the authority level for the estimated fee
sop: Compare the estimated fee against the authority matrix.
Record approval at the required level before retention is signed.
Done when approval is recorded for the estimated fee.
verify: Check the approver level against the fee threshold.
Pass when approval meets the required level.

steps.title: Execute the retention letter with rates and scope
sop: Issue the retention letter stating rates, scope and reporting duties.
Obtain the expert signature and file the executed letter.
Done when the signed retention letter is on the claim.
verify: Read the filed letter for signature, rates and scope.
Pass when all three are present.

steps.title: Record the retention against the vendor in ClaimCenter
sop: Create the vendor assignment record against the approved panel vendor.
Link the signed retention letter to that record.
Done when the retention is recorded against the panel vendor.
verify: Open the vendor record and confirm the linked retention letter.
Pass when the letter is linked to the panel vendor record.

generic.Evidence location: Review note in ClaimCenter and the preliminary findings in the claim repository.

steps.title: Open the preliminary findings on the diary date
sop: Open the preliminary findings from the claim repository on the diary date.
Record the review date against the expert assignment activity.
Done when the review is started on or before the diary date.
verify: Compare the review date against the diary date.
Pass when the review is not later than the diary date.

steps.title: List areas the expert could not access or test
sop: Read the findings for areas not inspected, tested or reached.
Record each as a scope gap with the reason given.
Done when every stated limitation is recorded as a gap.
verify: Compare the recorded gaps against the report limitations section.
Pass when every limitation appears as a gap.

steps.title: Test the preliminary conclusion against the liability position
sop: Compare the preliminary conclusion against the current liability position.
Record whether the position strengthens, weakens or is unchanged.
Done when the liability effect is recorded.
verify: Read the note for an explicit liability effect statement.
Pass when the effect is stated.

steps.title: Review and adjust the reserve where exposure moves
sop: Assess whether the preliminary finding changes the exposure estimate.
Adjust the reserve in ClaimCenter or record why no change is needed.
Done when the reserve is adjusted or the no-change reason is recorded.
verify: Compare the reserve action against the recorded exposure change.
Pass when the action matches the exposure assessment.

steps.title: Decide whether to proceed to final report or redirect scope
sop: Weigh the gaps and findings against the remaining fee budget.
Record the decision to proceed to final report or redirect the scope.
Done when the decision is recorded on the claim.
verify: Read the recorded decision against the gap list.
Pass when the decision addresses the identified gaps.

steps.title: File the review note on the claim
sop: Write the review note covering findings, gaps, liability effect and decision.
File it against the expert assignment in ClaimCenter.
Done when the dated review note is filed.
verify: Open the filed note and check all four elements are present.
Pass when the note covers findings, gaps, effect and decision.

generic.Defined scope/population: All parties and non-parties alleged to have contributed to this loss.
generic.In-scope period: From completion of the liability evidence gathering to the liability determination.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each party shows a fault percentage, the basis cited and the negligence rule applied.

generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Apportionment workbook saved with its version date and cited evidence references.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Phantom-vehicle or non-party allegations logged with the treatment applied.

generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fault percentages recorded per party totalling 100%.
generic.Exception handling path: Disputed apportionment escalated to the Claims Examiner before communication.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Apportionment accepted when each percentage cites evidence and sits in the system fields.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter liability fields and the apportionment workbook in the claim repository.

steps.title: List all parties and alleged contributors in Excel
sop: Open the apportionment workbook in Microsoft Excel for this claim.
List the insured, each claimant and any non-party alleged to contribute.
Done when every alleged contributor is listed.
verify: Compare the list against the claim party record and statements.
Pass when no alleged contributor is missing.

steps.title: Apply the loss state negligence rule
sop: Read the researched negligence rule for the loss state on the claim.
Apply pure comparative, modified comparative or contributory to the allocation.
Done when the applied rule is named in the workbook.
verify: Compare the applied rule against the jurisdiction research note.
Pass when the rule matches the research.

steps.title: Assign a percentage to each party
sop: Assign a fault percentage to each listed party based on the evidence.
Adjust the allocation until the percentages total 100%.
Done when the assigned percentages sum to 100%.
verify: Sum the percentage column in the workbook.
Pass when the total equals 100%.

steps.title: Cite the basis for each percentage
sop: For each percentage, cite the statement, report or photograph relied on.
Record the citation in the basis column beside the percentage.
Done when every percentage carries a citation.
verify: Filter the basis column for blanks.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Address non-party and phantom-vehicle contributions
sop: Assess any allegation involving an unidentified vehicle or non-party.
Record how that allegation is treated in the allocation.
Done when each such allegation has a recorded treatment.
verify: Check each allegation in the statements has a recorded treatment.
Pass when none is left unaddressed.

steps.title: Enter the apportionment into the ClaimCenter liability fields
sop: Enter each party percentage into the ClaimCenter liability fields.
Attach the apportionment workbook to the claim as support.
Done when the system fields carry the apportionment.
verify: Compare the system field values against the workbook.
Pass when the values match and total 100%.

steps.title: Check statutory defences for the loss jurisdiction

Record which statutory defences are live on this claim.
Done when each statutory defence has a recorded position.
verify: Compare the positions against the jurisdiction research note.
Pass when each statutory defence has a recorded outcome.

steps.title: Assess factual defences against the evidence
sop: Assess sudden emergency, assumption of risk and open and obvious condition.
Record the evidence on file that supports or defeats each.
Done when each factual defence is assessed against the evidence.
verify: Check each factual defence cites filed evidence.
Pass when no factual defence is assessed without evidence.

steps.title: Check contractual defences in the policy system
sop: Read indemnity, hold-harmless and additional-insured provisions in the policy record.
Record any tender opportunity to another carrier or party.
Done when contractual defences and tenders are recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded provisions against the policy documents.
Pass when the recorded provisions match the policy.

steps.title: Rate the viability of each defence
sop: Rate each defence as strong, arguable or weak on the evidence on file.
Record the reason for each rating beside it.
Done when every defence carries a rating and a reason.
verify: Filter the assessment for defences without a rating.
Pass when the filter returns none.

steps.title: Flag defences requiring expert support
sop: Identify defences that need technical or medical opinion to succeed.
Flag each for expert assignment with the discipline required.
Done when each such defence is flagged with a discipline.
verify: Compare the flags against the expert assignment list.
Pass when every flagged defence has a discipline named.

steps.title: File the defence assessment on the claim
sop: Write the assessment covering all three defence categories.
File it in the claim repository and note it in ClaimCenter.
Done when the dated assessment is filed on the claim.
verify: Open the filed assessment and check all categories appear.
Pass when statutory, factual and contractual sections are present.

generic.Defined scope/population: Communication of the preliminary liability position to the insured and the claimant side.

generic.Evidence location: Liability position letters in the claim repository and ClaimCenter contact notes.

steps.title: Read the documented liability determination in ClaimCenter
sop: Open the recorded liability determination and apportionment on the claim.
Note the position to be communicated to each party.
Done when the position for each party is identified.
verify: Compare the noted position against the recorded determination.
Pass when the two match.

steps.title: Advise the insured of the position and any excess exposure
sop: Write to the insured stating the liability position in plain terms.
Warn of any exposure above the policy limits where it exists.
Done when the insured letter is sent and filed.
verify: Read the sent letter for the position and any excess warning.
Pass when both appear where excess exposure exists.

steps.title: Advise the claimant or claimant counsel in writing
sop: Write to the claimant or their counsel stating the liability position.
Route through counsel where representation has been notified.
Done when the claimant-side letter is sent and filed.
verify: Check the addressee against the representation flag on the claim.
Pass when represented claimants were addressed through counsel.

steps.title: Check the wording against the documented determination
sop: Read both letters against the recorded determination.
Remove any statement that admits more than the determination supports.
Done when the wording matches the determination scope.
verify: Compare each assertion in the letters to the determination.
Pass when no assertion exceeds the determination.

steps.title: Reference any reservation of rights where coverage is open
sop: Check whether any coverage question remains unresolved.
Reference the existing reservation of rights in the insured letter.
Done when open coverage issues are referenced in the letter.
verify: Compare the letter against the coverage position on the claim.
Pass when open coverage issues are referenced.

steps.title: File letters and call notes within 24 hours
sop: File the sent letters in the claim repository.
Log a note of any call communicating the position on the same day.
Done when letters and call notes are filed within 24 hours.
verify: Compare filing timestamps against the send and call times.
Pass when filing occurred within 24 hours.

generic.Defined scope/population: The liability decision recorded on the claim for this loss.

generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Decisions later reversed logged with the new evidence and revised outcome.

steps.title: Set the liability decision field in ClaimCenter

Set the decision to accepted, denied or the agreed percentage.
Done when the decision field holds a value.
verify: Compare the field value against the determination document.
Pass when the two agree.

steps.title: Record the decision date on the claim

Use the determination date rather than the data entry date.
Done when the decision date is recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded date against the determination document date.
Pass when the dates match.

steps.title: Capture the decision maker and authority level
sop: Record the name of the person who made the decision.
Record the authority level held against the claim exposure.
Done when name and authority level are captured.
verify: Compare the authority level against the exposure and matrix.
Pass when the level covers the exposure.

steps.title: Link the evidence documents relied on
sop: List the documents relied on in reaching the decision.
Quote their document identifiers in the decision claim note.
Done when the note links to each relied-on document.
verify: Open two linked identifiers from the note.
Pass when both open the expected documents.

steps.title: Confirm the decision precedes settlement negotiation
sop: Check the claim for any settlement discussion before the decision date.
Halt negotiation where the decision has not been recorded.
Done when the decision is confirmed to precede negotiation.
verify: Compare the earliest negotiation note against the decision date.
Pass when the decision date is earlier.

steps.title: Review and confirm the recorded decision
sop: Review the decision fields, date, maker and evidence links.
Record examiner confirmation on the claim.
Done when the examiner confirmation is recorded.
verify: Read the confirmation note against the decision fields.
Pass when the confirmation covers all four elements.

steps.title: Structure the determination by liability element

Write the reasoning for each element under its section.
Done when all four elements are addressed in order.
verify: Read the section headings and their content.
Pass when each element has its own reasoned section.

steps.title: Cite a document identifier for each factual assertion

Remove or evidence any assertion that cannot be cited.
Done when every assertion carries a citation.
verify: Sample three assertions and open their citations.
Pass when the cited sources support the assertions.

steps.title: Name the negligence standard and jurisdiction
sop: State the loss jurisdiction and the negligence standard applied.
Reference the jurisdiction research note held on the claim.
Done when standard and jurisdiction are named in the determination.
verify: Compare the named standard against the research note.
Pass when the two agree.

steps.title: Address contrary evidence explicitly
sop: Identify evidence that cuts against the determination.
State that evidence and explain why it does not change the outcome.
Done when contrary evidence is addressed in the text.
verify: Compare the contrary evidence section against the consistency note.
Pass when each known discrepancy is addressed.

steps.title: Route for examiner review above adjuster authority
sop: Compare the exposure against the adjuster authority threshold.
Review and record approval where the exposure exceeds it.
Done when review is complete for over-authority exposures.
verify: Check the exposure against the authority matrix.
Pass when over-authority determinations show examiner review.

steps.title: File the determination on the claim
sop: Save the determination with its version and date to the claim repository.
Link it to the liability decision record in ClaimCenter.
Done when the determination is filed and linked.
verify: Open the determination from the liability decision record.
Pass when the linked document is the filed version.

steps.title: Identify the duty owed and its legal source

Record whether the source is statute, common law or contract.
Done when the duty and its source are recorded.
verify: Check the recorded source against the jurisdiction research note.
Pass when the source is named and supported.

steps.title: Tie breach to a specific act or omission

verify: Open the cited evidence for the breach assertion.

sop: Compare the claimed damages against the medical records and repair estimates.
Record which damages are evidenced and which are unsupported.
Done when the damages element is tested against filed evidence.
verify: Check each claimed head of damage against filed evidence.

Record it as an investigation gap with the evidence required.

verify: Compare the gap list against the element assessments.

steps.title: Order the police or incident report

Done when photographs from each party are requested and filed.
verify: Compare filed photograph sources against the party list.

verify: Compare the noted content against the decision fields.

steps.title: Create the notification activity to the file owner
sop: Create a ClaimCenter activity addressed to the file owner.
Do not rely on a verbal handover in place of the activity.
Done when the notification activity exists on the claim.
verify: Check the activity assignee is the recorded file owner.
Pass when the assignee matches the file owner.

steps.title: State the outcome and apportionment percentage
sop: Write the liability outcome and any apportionment percentage in the activity.
Reference the determination document identifier.
Done when outcome and percentage are stated in the activity.
verify: Compare the stated percentage against the liability fields.
Pass when the figures match.

steps.title: Flag reserve and settlement-authority implications
sop: Assess whether the decision moves the reserve or the authority needed.
State both implications in the notification activity.
Done when reserve and authority implications are stated.
verify: Read the activity for both implication statements.
Pass when both are present.

steps.title: Issue the notification within 24 hours
sop: Send the notification activity on the day of the decision where possible.
Record the reason where issue exceeds 24 hours.
Done when the notification is issued and any delay explained.
verify: Measure hours between decision and notification.
Pass when 24 hours or fewer or a reason is recorded.

steps.title: Record the file owner acknowledgement
sop: Chase acknowledgement if none is received within one business day.
Record the acknowledgement date and time on the claim.
Done when the acknowledgement is recorded or escalated.
verify: Open the claim notes for the acknowledgement entry.
Pass when an acknowledgement or escalation is recorded.

generic.Defined scope/population: Expert assessments needed where a liability dispute turns on technical facts.
generic.In-scope period: From identification of the technical dispute until the assessment is filed.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each assessment shows the theory addressed, materials supplied and the written conclusion.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Assessments received equal the disputed liability theories referred to experts.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Written assessments filed on the claim with receipt dates and report versions.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Assessments not obtained logged with the cost-benefit rationale.
generic.Test population: All liability disputes turning on technical or engineering facts.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Written assessment filed before the liability determination is finalised.
generic.Exception handling path: Cost disproportionate to exposure escalated for a no-assessment decision.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Assessment accepted when it addresses the disputed theory in writing with reasoning.
generic.Evidence location: Expert assessment report in the claim repository linked to the liability workstream.

steps.title: Confirm the dispute turns on technical facts
sop: Read the liability dispute and identify the technical question at its centre.
Confirm adjuster investigation alone cannot resolve it.
Done when the technical question is stated on the claim.
verify: Check the stated question against the disputed liability theory.
Pass when the question is genuinely technical.

steps.title: Weigh assessment cost against the exposure
sop: Compare the expected assessment cost against the claim exposure.
Record the rationale for proceeding or not proceeding.
Done when the cost-benefit rationale is documented.
verify: Read the rationale against the recorded exposure figure.
Pass when the rationale references the exposure.

steps.title: Supply the expert with scene, photograph and vehicle data
sop: Send scene measurements, photographs and vehicle data to the expert.
List the materials supplied in the instruction on the claim.
Done when the material package is sent and listed.
verify: Compare the supplied list against the claim evidence index.
Pass when the relevant evidence was supplied.

steps.title: Instruct the expert on the specific liability theory
sop: State the disputed liability theory the expert must address.
Ask for a written opinion on that theory rather than a general review.
Done when the instruction names the theory to be addressed.
verify: Read the instruction for the named theory.
Pass when the theory is explicitly stated.

steps.title: Receive and file the written assessment
sop: Receive the written assessment and attach it to the claim.
Confirm it addresses the theory stated in the instruction.
Done when the assessment is filed and checked for scope.
verify: Compare the assessment content against the instruction theory.
Pass when the theory is addressed in writing.

steps.title: Confirm filing before the determination is finalised
sop: Check the assessment is on the claim before the determination is drafted.
Hold the determination where the assessment is outstanding.
Done when the determination proceeds only with the assessment filed.
verify: Compare the assessment filing date against the determination date.
Pass when the assessment predates the determination.

generic.Defined scope/population: The event sequence from pre-loss conditions through to post-loss observations.
generic.In-scope period: The period from pre-loss events to the post-loss scene documentation.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Timeline entries show date, time, source and the physical evidence mapped to them.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Timeline entries reconcile to the statements and reports they are drawn from.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Timeline and scene diagram filed with their version dates on the claim.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Conflicting accounts shown side by side with the divergence recorded.
generic.Test population: All statements, reports and physical evidence bearing on the sequence.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Reconstruction timeline attached with a scene diagram on the claim.
generic.Exception handling path: Unresolvable conflicts escalated for reconstruction expert consideration.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Reconstruction accepted when the conclusion states confidence and remaining unknowns.
generic.Evidence location: Timeline workbook and scene diagram in the claim repository linked to ClaimCenter.

steps.title: Build a dated timeline in the Excel workbook
sop: Open the reconstruction workbook in Microsoft Excel for this claim.
Enter dated and timed entries from pre-loss through post-loss.
Done when the timeline covers all three phases.
verify: Scan the timeline for entries missing a date or time.
Pass when every entry carries both.

steps.title: Cite the source for each timeline entry
sop: For each entry, cite the statement, report or record it comes from.
Remove any entry that has no documentary source.
Done when every entry carries a source citation.
verify: Filter the source column for blanks.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Map physical evidence to each timeline step
sop: Map damage profile, skid marks and debris field to the relevant steps.
Note where physical evidence contradicts a step.
Done when physical evidence is mapped across the sequence.
verify: Compare the mapping against the scene photographs.
Pass when each mapped item is evidenced by a photograph.

steps.title: Show conflicting accounts side by side
sop: Place the differing accounts in adjacent columns at the divergence points.
Mark clearly which party gave each account.
Done when the divergence points display both accounts.
verify: Check each divergence shows the accounts and their parties.
Pass when both appear at every divergence.

steps.title: Attach the scene sketch or reconstruction diagram
sop: Produce or obtain a scene sketch showing positions and directions.
Attach the diagram to the claim in ClaimCenter.
Done when the diagram is attached to the claim.
verify: Open the attached diagram from the claim document list.
Pass when the diagram opens and matches the timeline.

steps.title: State the conclusion with confidence and unknowns
sop: Write the reconstruction conclusion in a claim note.
State the confidence level and list the unknowns that remain.
Done when the conclusion, confidence and unknowns are recorded.
verify: Read the note for all three elements.
Pass when confidence and unknowns are both stated.

generic.Defined scope/population: The negligence rules, limitation period and damage rules of the loss jurisdiction.
generic.In-scope period: From liability evaluation start until the limitation expiry date is diarised.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Research shows the state, rule type, limitation expiry, caps and any case-law change.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Research summary covers every rule category on the jurisdiction checklist.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Research summary attached to the claim with its research date and citations.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Uncertain or conflicting authority logged with the position taken.
generic.Test population: All claims requiring a liability determination in this area.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Limitation expiry date diarised and matching the researched jurisdiction.
generic.Exception handling path: Ambiguous jurisdiction questions escalated to the Claims Examiner and coverage counsel.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Research accepted when rule, limitation, caps and case-law changes are all recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Jurisdiction research summary in the claim repository and the ClaimCenter diary.

steps.title: Identify the loss state and name its negligence rule
sop: Read the loss location from the claim record in ClaimCenter.
Record whether the state applies pure comparative, modified or contributory.
Done when the state and its rule type are recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded rule against the researched source.
Pass when the rule matches the cited authority.

steps.title: Record the limitation period and its expiry date
sop: Identify the limitation period for the cause of action in that state.
Calculate the expiry date from the date of loss or accrual.
Done when the limitation expiry date is recorded.
verify: Recompute the expiry from the loss date and period.
Pass when the recomputed date matches.

steps.title: Diarise the limitation expiry in ClaimCenter
sop: Create a diary entry ahead of the limitation expiry date.
Assign the diary to the file owner and mark it as limitation critical.
Done when the limitation diary entry exists.
verify: Compare the diary date against the recorded expiry.
Pass when the diary precedes the expiry date.

steps.title: Check damage caps, joint liability and no-fault thresholds
sop: Check the state for damage caps and joint-and-several liability rules.
Check any no-fault injury threshold applying to this loss type.
Done when all three checks are recorded.
verify: Read the research summary for the three check results.
Pass when all three are recorded.

steps.title: Search LexisNexis Risk for recent case-law change
sop: Search for recent decisions affecting the negligence rule in that state.
Note any change with its citation in the research summary.
Done when the case-law check is recorded with citations.
verify: Check each noted change carries a citation.
Pass when every noted change is cited.

steps.title: Attach the research summary to the claim
sop: Review the summary for completeness against the rule categories.
Attach the dated summary to the claim so it can support the determination.
Done when the reviewed summary is attached to the claim.
verify: Open the attached summary from the claim document list.
Pass when it covers rule, limitation, caps and case law.

generic.Defined scope/population: Bodily injury damages subject to comparative-fault reduction on this claim.
generic.In-scope period: From the apportionment being documented until the reduced valuation is loaded.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Calculation shows gross damages, fault percentage, reduction and net figure.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Applied fault percentage matches the apportionment recorded on the file.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Calculation workbook saved with its version date on the claim.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Claimant fault above the state threshold logged with the no-payment position.
generic.Test population: All bodily injury exposures where claimant fault is alleged.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Comparative-fault percentage and reduced damages figure recorded on the evaluation.
generic.Exception handling path: Threshold-barred claims escalated to the Liability Claims Specialist before any payment.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Reduction accepted when applied before liens and the net figure is reproducible.
generic.Evidence location: Evaluation fields in ClaimCenter and the calculation workbook in Excel.

steps.title: Read the documented apportionment from the claim
sop: Open the ClaimCenter liability fields and read the fault percentages.
Note the claimant fault percentage to be applied.
Done when the claimant fault percentage is confirmed.
verify: Compare the noted percentage against the apportionment record.
Pass when the figures match.

steps.title: Check the modified-comparative bar for the loss state
sop: Compare the claimant fault percentage against the state threshold.
Record a no-payment position where the threshold is exceeded.
Done when the threshold test result is recorded.
verify: Compare the test against the jurisdiction research note.
Pass when the threshold applied matches the state rule.

steps.title: Apply the reduction to gross damages in Excel
sop: Enter the gross damages figure before liens and offsets.
Apply the claimant fault percentage to that gross figure.
Done when the reduction is applied to gross damages.
verify: Check the reduction was applied before liens were deducted.
Pass when the order of operations is gross then reduction.

steps.title: Show the calculation line by line
sop: Show gross damages, the percentage, the reduction and the net on separate lines.
Avoid embedding the calculation in a single unexplained figure.
Done when each calculation step appears on its own line.
verify: Recompute the net figure from the shown lines.
Pass when the recomputed net matches the stated net.

steps.title: Load the reduced valuation into the ClaimCenter evaluation fields
sop: Enter the reduced valuation into the claim system evaluation screen.
Attach the calculation workbook as support.
Done when the evaluation fields hold the reduced figure.
verify: Compare the evaluation field value against the workbook net.
Pass when the two agree.

steps.title: Record the fault percentage on the evaluation
sop: Record the applied comparative-fault percentage on the evaluation.
Note the apportionment document it was taken from.
Done when percentage and source are recorded on the evaluation.
verify: Read the evaluation for the percentage and its source reference.
Pass when both appear.

generic.Defined scope/population: Non-economic damages including pain and suffering for each injured claimant.
generic.In-scope period: From completion of the medical review until the injury valuation is calculated.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Assessment shows venue, comparables used, matching factors and the low likely high range.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: General damages figure reconciles to the specials multiplier used in the valuation.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Comparable data and range workbook saved with the extraction date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Comparables rejected as unmatched logged with the reason.
generic.Test population: All bodily injury exposures requiring a general damages assessment.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: General damages range supported by venue-specific verdict comparables.
generic.Exception handling path: Thin venue data escalated to the Complex Claims Specialist for a wider search.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Assessment accepted when comparables match injury, duration and permanency.
generic.Evidence location: Comparables workbook in Excel and the evaluation note on the ClaimCenter claim.

steps.title: Identify the venue for the claim
sop: Identify the court venue where the claim would be tried.
Record the venue on the evaluation note in ClaimCenter.
Done when the venue is recorded.
verify: Compare the venue against the loss location and claimant residence.
Pass when the venue is supported by the claim facts.

steps.title: Pull venue-specific verdict and settlement comparables
sop: Search LexisNexis Risk for verdicts and settlements in that venue.
Export the comparables into the Excel workbook for the claim.
Done when venue comparables are held in the workbook.
verify: Check each comparable is from the identified venue.
Pass when no national-average figure is relied on.

steps.title: Match comparables on injury, duration and permanency
sop: Filter the comparables to matching injury type and treatment duration.
Reject comparables that do not match permanency and log the reason.
Done when only matched comparables remain.
verify: Check the retained comparables against the claimant injury profile.
Pass when each retained comparable matches on all three factors.

steps.title: Document the low, likely and high range
sop: Derive a low, likely and high figure from the matched comparables.
Record all three in the evaluation workbook.
Done when the three-point range is documented.
verify: Check the range sits within the matched comparable spread.
Pass when the figures fall inside the comparable data.

steps.title: Note venue characteristics affecting jury awards
sop: Note venue tendencies that raise or lower awards for this injury type.
Cite the source for each noted characteristic.
Done when venue characteristics are noted with sources.
verify: Check each noted characteristic carries a source.
Pass when no characteristic is asserted without a source.

steps.title: Reconcile general damages to the specials multiplier
sop: Divide the likely general damages figure by the audited specials total.
Record the implied multiplier and explain any outlier.
Done when the multiplier is recorded and explained.
verify: Recompute the multiplier from the recorded figures.
Pass when the recomputed value matches the recorded one.

generic.Defined scope/population: Permanency findings and projected future medical costs for each injured claimant.
generic.In-scope period: From maximum medical improvement assessment through the projected treatment horizon.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Projection shows treatment items, frequency, duration, unit cost and permanency evidence.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Projected cost total equals the sum of the itemised treatment lines.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Projection workbook and life-care plan filed with their version dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Items without supporting clinical opinion logged and excluded from the total.
generic.Test population: All claimants with alleged permanent injury or ongoing treatment need.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every projected item supported by an impairment rating or physician opinion.
generic.Exception handling path: Medicare beneficiaries escalated for set-aside consideration before settlement.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Projection accepted when itemised, evidenced and present-valued where required.
generic.Evidence location: Future medical projection workbook in Excel filed on the ClaimCenter claim.

steps.title: Confirm permanency from the medical records
sop: Read the records for an impairment rating or treating-physician opinion.
Record the permanency finding and its source on the claim.
Done when permanency is evidenced or recorded as unsupported.
verify: Open the cited record page for the permanency opinion.
Pass when the cited page contains the opinion.

steps.title: Itemise future treatment with frequency and duration
sop: List each anticipated treatment, procedure and device.
Record the frequency and duration for each item in the workbook.
Done when every item shows frequency and duration.
verify: Filter the workbook for items missing frequency or duration.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Apply unit costs to each treatment line
sop: Apply the fee schedule or usual and customary unit cost to each line.
Total the itemised lines to the projected future medical cost.
Done when every line carries a unit cost and the total is computed.
verify: Re-sum the itemised lines against the stated total.
Pass when the sum equals the total.

steps.title: Obtain a life-care plan for significant permanency
sop: Where permanency is significant or catastrophic, commission a life-care plan.
File the plan on the claim and reconcile it to the projection.
Done when the life-care plan is obtained or ruled out with reasons.
verify: Check catastrophic claimants have a filed life-care plan.
Pass when none is missing without a recorded reason.

steps.title: Check Medicare entitlement and set-aside need
sop: Check whether the claimant is a Medicare beneficiary or soon will be.
Record whether a set-aside must be considered before settlement.
Done when the entitlement check and set-aside position are recorded.
verify: Read the recorded entitlement result on the claim.
Pass when the check outcome is explicit.

steps.title: Reduce the projection to present value where required
sop: Check whether the jurisdiction requires present-value discounting.
Apply the discount rate and show the discounted total.
Done when the projection shows the required present value.
verify: Recompute the discounted total from the rate and horizon.
Pass when the recomputed figure matches.

generic.Defined scope/population: All medical bills submitted on the claim for the injured claimants.
generic.In-scope period: The treatment dates covered by the submitted bills and the medical records.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each bill shows treatment date, CPT and ICD codes, allowed amount and audit outcome.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Billed total less reductions equals the allowed total on the audit schedule.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Audit schedule saved with its version date and the fee schedule version used.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Duplicates, unbundling and unrelated treatment logged with the exclusion reason.
generic.Test population: Every medical bill submitted on the claim.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No submitted bill paid without a recorded allowed amount and audit outcome.
generic.Exception handling path: Disputed reductions escalated to the Medical Claims Reviewer for provider negotiation.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Audit accepted when every bill is matched, coded, priced and dispositioned.
generic.Evidence location: Bill audit schedule in Excel filed against the ClaimCenter medical exposure.

steps.title: Load submitted bills into the Excel audit schedule
sop: List every submitted bill with provider, date, codes and amount.
Confirm the schedule count matches the bills received on the claim.
Done when all submitted bills are on the schedule.
verify: Compare the schedule count against the bills attached in ClaimCenter.
Pass when the counts match.

steps.title: Match each bill to a treatment date in the records
sop: Find the treatment date for each bill in the medical records.
Flag bills with no matching treatment date in the records.
Done when every bill is matched or flagged.
verify: Filter the schedule for unmatched bills without a flag.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Check CPT and ICD codes against the fee schedule
sop: Price each line against the state fee schedule or usual and customary data.
Record the schedule allowance beside each billed amount.
Done when every line carries a schedule allowance.
verify: Spot-check three lines against the fee schedule.
Pass when the checked allowances match the schedule.

steps.title: Flag duplicate billing and unbundled code combinations
sop: Sort by provider, date and code to identify duplicates.
Flag unbundled combinations that should have been billed as one code.
Done when duplicates and unbundling are flagged.
verify: Re-sort and check for unflagged repeated code and date pairs.
Pass when no duplicate remains unflagged.

steps.title: Exclude treatment unrelated to the loss
sop: Compare the diagnosis codes against the injuries established for this loss.
Exclude unrelated treatment and record the reason on the line.
Done when unrelated lines are excluded with reasons.
verify: Read the exclusion reasons against the established injury list.
Pass when each exclusion has a stated reason.

steps.title: Record the allowed amount and rationale per bill
sop: Record the final allowed amount for each bill on the schedule.
Record the reduction rationale where the allowance is below the billed amount.
Done when every bill shows an allowed amount and outcome.
verify: Filter the schedule for bills without an allowed amount.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

generic.Defined scope/population: The full injury claim value covering specials, general damages and deductions.
generic.In-scope period: From completion of the bill audit and wage evaluation to the reserve alignment.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Valuation shows specials, general damages, fault reduction, limits, liens and net value.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Specials total equals audited bills plus documented wage loss.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Valuation workbook saved with its version date and linked to the evaluation screen.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unverified lien amounts logged with the estimate basis and follow-up.
generic.Test population: All bodily injury exposures requiring a valuation.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Valuation shows specials, general damages, reductions and net value separately.
generic.Exception handling path: Valuations above authority escalated to the Liability Claims Specialist for review.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Valuation accepted when entered on the evaluation screen with the reserve aligned.
generic.Evidence location: Valuation workbook in Excel and the ClaimCenter evaluation screen.

steps.title: Total the specials from audited bills and wage loss
sop: Take the allowed totals from the bill audit schedule.
Add the documented wage loss figure to reach the specials total.
Done when the specials total is computed from both sources.
verify: Re-add the audit and wage figures.
Pass when the sum equals the recorded specials.

steps.title: Bring in the general damages figure from the venue range
sop: Take the likely general damages figure from the venue comparables work.
Enter it into the valuation workbook as a separate line.
Done when general damages appear as their own line.
verify: Compare the entered figure against the documented range.
Pass when the figure sits inside the documented range.

steps.title: Apply the comparative-fault reduction and policy limits
sop: Apply the documented fault percentage to the gross value.
Cap the result at the applicable policy limit where it is exceeded.
Done when reduction and limits are both applied.
verify: Compare the applied percentage and limit against the claim records.
Pass when both match the recorded values.

steps.title: Deduct liens, subrogation interests and set-offs
sop: List every known lien, subrogation interest and set-off.
Deduct them to reach the net settlement value.
Done when all known deductions are applied.
verify: Compare the deduction list against the lien notices on the claim.
Pass when every notified lien is deducted or explained.

steps.title: Enter the valuation on the ClaimCenter evaluation screen
sop: Enter specials, general damages, reductions and net value on the screen.
Attach the valuation workbook as supporting evidence.
Done when the evaluation screen carries the full valuation.
verify: Compare the screen values against the workbook.
Pass when each field matches the workbook.

steps.title: Align the reserve to the valuation
sop: Compare the current reserve against the net valuation.
Adjust the reserve or record why the current level remains appropriate.
Done when the reserve is aligned or the variance is explained.
verify: Compare the reserve figure against the net valuation.
Pass when they agree or a variance reason is recorded.

generic.Defined scope/population: The claimant treatment plan and return-to-function milestones with treating providers.
generic.In-scope period: From case management start until return to function or case closure.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Plan shows treatment duration, dated milestones, provider contacts and barrier actions.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Logged provider contacts reconcile to the diarised review points on the plan.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Plan and contact log saved with each update date on the claim.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Barriers to recovery logged with the action taken and its outcome.
generic.Test population: All claimants under active medical case management.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every plan milestone carries a date and a recorded progress review.
generic.Exception handling path: Stalled recovery escalated to the Medical Claims Reviewer for clinical review.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Plan accepted when milestones, provider contacts and barrier actions are all documented.
generic.Evidence location: Case management plan and contact log in the claim repository on ClaimCenter.

steps.title: Obtain the treatment plan from the treating provider
sop: Contact the treating provider and request the current treatment plan.
Record the expected treatment duration on the claim.
Done when the plan and duration are on the claim.
verify: Read the filed plan for the stated treatment duration.
Pass when the duration is documented.

steps.title: Agree dated return-to-function milestones
sop: Agree functional and return-to-work milestones with the provider.
Record each milestone with its target date.
Done when every milestone carries a target date.
verify: Filter the milestone list for missing dates.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Keep a provider contact log with clinical updates
sop: Log every provider check-in with date and the clinical update received.
File the log against the claim in ClaimCenter.
Done when each contact is logged with its update.
verify: Review the log for contacts without a clinical update.
Pass when every contact carries an update.

steps.title: Identify barriers to recovery and act on them
sop: Identify comorbidities, transport issues and authorisation delays.
Record the action taken against each identified barrier.
Done when every barrier has a recorded action.
verify: Check each barrier entry for a recorded action.
Pass when none is left without an action.

steps.title: Review plan progress on the diary date
sop: Review progress against the milestones on each diary date.
Update the file note with the outcome of each review.
Done when each diarised review has a file note.
verify: Compare review notes against the diary entries.
Pass when every diary point has a review note.

steps.title: Escalate stalled recovery to the reviewer
sop: Identify milestones missed by more than one review cycle.
Escalate to the Medical Claims Reviewer for clinical reassessment.
Done when stalled milestones are escalated.
verify: Check missed milestones for an escalation entry.
Pass when every missed milestone is escalated.

generic.Defined scope/population: The bodily injury evaluation summary and the reserve recommendation for this exposure.
generic.In-scope period: From completion of the injury valuation to the same-day reserve posting.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Summary states specials, general damages, fault reduction and the recommended reserve.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Recommended reserve reconciles to the net valuation on the evaluation screen.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Summary and workbook saved with the evaluation date on the claim.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Movements above the approval threshold logged with the approval decision.
generic.Test population: All bodily injury exposures with a completed valuation.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Reserve recommendation carries a written rationale rather than a rounded figure.
generic.Exception handling path: Threshold-breaching movements routed to the Claims Examiner before posting.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Recommendation accepted when rationale, movement explanation and approval are present.
generic.Evidence location: Evaluation summary in the claim repository and the ClaimCenter reserve screen.

steps.title: Write the evaluation summary with components separated
sop: State specials, general damages and the fault reduction on separate lines.
Show the net value after all deductions.
Done when each component is stated separately.
verify: Recompute the net from the stated components.
Pass when the recomputed net matches.

steps.title: Draft the reserve recommendation with rationale
sop: State the recommended reserve figure derived from the valuation.
Write the rationale linking it to the valuation components.
Done when the recommendation carries a written rationale.
verify: Read the rationale against the valuation components.
Pass when the rationale supports the recommended figure.

steps.title: Compare the recommendation against the current reserve
sop: Read the current reserve from the ClaimCenter reserve screen.
State the movement and explain what drove it.
Done when the movement and its driver are stated.
verify: Recompute the movement from current and recommended figures.
Pass when the stated movement matches.

steps.title: Route movements above threshold for approval
sop: Compare the movement against the manager approval threshold.
Approve or decline before the reserve is posted.
Done when threshold-breaching movements have a recorded decision.
verify: Check the movement value against the approval threshold.
Pass when over-threshold movements show an approval.

steps.title: Post the reserve recommendation the same day
sop: Enter the recommended reserve on the ClaimCenter reserve screen.
Post on the day the evaluation is completed.
Done when the reserve is posted on the evaluation date.
verify: Compare the posting date against the evaluation date.
Pass when the dates are the same.

steps.title: File the evaluation summary on the claim
sop: Save the summary and workbook to the claim repository.
Link them to the reserve entry in ClaimCenter.
Done when the summary is filed and linked to the reserve.
verify: Open the summary from the reserve entry.
Pass when the linked document is the filed summary.

generic.Defined scope/population: Independent medical examinations and peer reviews where treating opinions are disputed.
generic.In-scope period: From the dispute being identified until the report is compared to the treating opinion.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Referral states the dispute, examiner specialty, records sent and notice details.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Records package index matches the medical records held on the claim.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Referral, notice and report filed with their dates on the claim.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Claimant non-attendance logged with the reschedule or the consequence applied.
generic.Test population: All claims with a disputed causation, permanency or necessity opinion.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Report addresses the specific medical dispute stated in the referral.
generic.Exception handling path: Reports that miss the dispute returned to the examiner for supplemental opinion.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Engagement accepted when specialty, licensure, records and statutory notice are all correct.
generic.Evidence location: IME referral and report in the claim repository linked to the medical exposure.

steps.title: State the medical dispute in the referral
sop: Identify whether the dispute is causation, permanency or treatment necessity.
State the dispute as a question in the referral document.

verify: List the valuation attachments on the claim.
Pass when estimate, photographs and reports are all present.

steps.title: Reconcile field and contractor estimate variance
sop: Compare the field estimate against any contractor estimate line by line.
Explain each material variance in the valuation note.
Done when every material variance is explained.
verify: Recompute the variance from the two estimate totals.
Pass when the explained variance matches the computed one.

steps.title: Update the reserve to match the finalised valuation
sop: Compare the current reserve against the finalised valuation.
Post the reserve adjustment in ClaimCenter.
Done when the reserve equals the finalised valuation.
verify: Compare the reserve figure against the valuation total.
Pass when they are equal.

steps.title: Send the finalised estimate to the insured
sop: Send a copy of the finalised estimate to the insured.
Record the send date on the claim.
Done when the copy is sent and the date recorded.
verify: Read the recorded send date against the sent correspondence.
Pass when the dates agree.

steps.title: Lock the valuation version in the claim record
sop: Lock the finalised valuation version so it cannot be silently overwritten.
Note that later supplements must be tracked as separate versions.
Done when the version is locked on the claim.
verify: Check the valuation record for the locked status.
Pass when the version shows as locked.

steps.title: Record the finalisation in a claim note
sop: Write a note stating the finalised figure, exhibits and reserve action.
File the note against the valuation in ClaimCenter.
Done when the finalisation note is filed.
verify: Read the note for figure, exhibits and reserve action.
Pass when all three appear.

generic.Defined scope/population: Repair estimates from licensed contractors, body shops or preferred vendors for this loss.
generic.In-scope period: From inspection scope completion until the estimate is accepted or superseded.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each estimate shows vendor licence number, labour hours, rates and parts type.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Estimate lines reconcile to the inspection scope areas item by item.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Estimates and supplements filed with their dates and estimate numbers.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Estimates exceeding the tool-generated scope logged with the second estimate obtained.
generic.Test population: All repair estimates submitted on the claim.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Itemised estimate from a licensed vendor attached to the claim.
generic.Exception handling path: Unlicensed vendor estimates escalated to the Claims Adjuster and not accepted.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Estimate accepted when itemised, licence-evidenced and reconciled to the inspection scope.
generic.Evidence location: Repair estimates in the claim repository and the estimate record in CCC or Mitchell.

steps.title: Request estimates from licensed vendors
sop: Request repair estimates from licensed contractors or repair shops.
Provide the inspection scope so the estimate covers the same work.
Done when estimates are requested with the scope supplied.
verify: Check each request included the inspection scope.
Pass when every request carried the scope.

steps.title: Record the vendor licence number on the claim
sop: Obtain the licence number from each estimating vendor.
Record it against the estimate on the claim.
Done when every estimate shows a licence number.
verify: Filter the estimate records for missing licence numbers.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Check estimates are itemised with hours, rates and parts type
sop: Check each estimate itemises labour hours, rates and parts type.
Return estimates that give only a lump sum figure.
Done when every accepted estimate is itemised.
verify: Read two estimates for line-level hours and parts type.
Pass when both are itemised.

steps.title: Obtain a second estimate where the first exceeds tool scope
sop: Compare the estimate against the tool-generated scope total.
Request a second estimate where the difference is material.
Done when a second estimate is obtained or the variance is explained.
verify: Compare the estimate against the tool scope total.
Pass when material variances have a second estimate or explanation.

steps.title: Tie supplements to the original estimate number
sop: Require supplements to be submitted through the same channel.
Record the original estimate number on each supplement.
Done when every supplement references its original estimate.
verify: Check each supplement for the original estimate number.
Pass when every supplement carries it.

steps.title: Compare the estimate line by line against the inspection scope
sop: Compare each estimate line against the inspection scope item.
Query lines outside the inspected scope before accepting the estimate.
Done when every line is matched or queried.
verify: Count matched lines against the estimate line count.
Pass when every line is matched or queried.

generic.Defined scope/population: The assessed damage compared against the reported cause of loss on this claim.
generic.In-scope period: From the damage assessment being produced until the valuation is finalised.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Review note records the mechanism compared, inconsistencies found and photograph references.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Damage areas reviewed equal the areas priced on the damage assessment.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Consistency review filed on the claim with its review date and estimate version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Inconsistent damage logged with the SIU referral or the exclusion applied.
generic.Test population: Every damaged area included in the assessed scope.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Documented consistency review comparing damage pattern against the reported cause.
generic.Exception handling path: Red-flag inconsistencies referred to SIU before the valuation is finalised.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Review accepted when the pattern comparison and exclusion decisions are documented.
generic.Evidence location: Consistency review note in ClaimCenter and the estimate file in CCC or Mitchell.

steps.title: Read the reported cause and the assessed damage scope
sop: Read the reported cause of loss from the FNOL on the claim.
Read the assessed damage scope from the estimate.
Done when both are held for comparison.
verify: Check the scope read matches the current estimate version.
Pass when the versions align.

steps.title: Compare the damage pattern against the reported mechanism
sop: Compare impact direction, burn pattern or water line to the reported cause.
Record whether the pattern is consistent for each damaged area.
Done when every area has a consistency finding.
verify: Filter the review for areas without a finding.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: List inconsistent damage with photograph references
sop: List each area where the damage does not fit the reported cause.
Cite the photograph that shows the inconsistency.
Done when every inconsistency carries a photograph reference.
verify: Open two cited photographs from the review.
Pass when the photographs show the described inconsistency.

steps.title: Exclude prior or unrelated damage from the payable scope
sop: Identify prior or unrelated damage in the assessed scope.
Remove those lines from the payable scope with a stated reason.
Done when unrelated damage is excluded and reasoned.
verify: Compare the payable scope against the excluded lines.
Pass when no excluded line remains payable.

steps.title: Test inconsistencies against the red-flag checklist
sop: Test each inconsistency against the fraud red-flag indicators.
Refer to SIU where an indicator triggers and record the referral.
Done when every inconsistency is red-flag tested.
verify: Check each inconsistency for a recorded test result.
Pass when none is untested.

steps.title: Document the review conclusion before finalisation
sop: Write the review conclusion on consistency and payable scope.
File it on the claim before the valuation is finalised.
Done when the conclusion is filed ahead of finalisation.
verify: Compare the review date against the valuation finalisation date.
Pass when the review precedes finalisation.

generic.Defined scope/population: The property or vehicle valuation checked against local market comparable data.
generic.In-scope period: The valuation window in which comparables must be dated for this loss.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each comparable shows source, date, matching attributes and itemised adjustments.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Adjusted comparable values reconcile to the stated valuation figure.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Valuation report saved with its run date and the comparables used.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Comparables rejected as unmatched or stale logged with the reason.
generic.Test population: All total-loss and market-value determinations on the claim.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: At least three dated local comparables support the valuation.
generic.Exception handling path: Thin comparable data escalated to the Claims Examiner for a widened search.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Valuation accepted when comparables, adjustments and the threshold test are documented.
generic.Evidence location: Valuation report in the claim repository and the comparables workbook in Excel.

steps.title: Pull comparables from the local market
sop: Search LexisNexis Risk and market sources for comparable listings or sales.
Restrict the search to the local market area for the loss.
Done when at least three local comparables are held.
verify: Count the retained comparables and check their market area.
Pass when three or more are local to the loss.

steps.title: Match comparables on the key attributes
sop: Match vehicles on make, model and trim, or property on size, age and condition.
Reject unmatched comparables and record the reason.
Done when only matched comparables remain.
verify: Check each retained comparable against the attribute list.
Pass when every retained comparable matches.

steps.title: Check comparables fall inside the valuation window
sop: Read the date of each comparable listing or sale.
Reject any comparable dated outside the valuation window.
Done when all retained comparables are in date.
verify: Compare each comparable date against the window.
Pass when all fall inside it.

steps.title: Itemise adjustments in the Excel workbook
sop: Enter adjustments for mileage, options or condition as separate lines.
Avoid applying a single unexplained lump-sum adjustment.
Done when every adjustment is itemised.
verify: Recompute the adjusted values from the itemised lines.
Pass when the recomputed values match.

steps.title: Apply the total-loss threshold for the loss state
sop: Compare the repair cost against the market value and the state threshold.
Record whether the loss is a total loss under that threshold.
Done when the threshold test result is recorded.
verify: Recompute the ratio against the state threshold.
Pass when the recorded result matches the computation.

steps.title: Attach the valuation report and send a copy to the insured
sop: Attach the valuation report with its comparables to the claim.
Send a copy to the insured and record the send date.
Done when the report is attached and the copy sent.
verify: Open the attached report and check the send record.
Pass when both the attachment and send date exist.
